name: Booking Calendar — Bookings
description: One row per booking. slotLock + its unique index stop two bookings from taking the same host + start.

subject.description: What the meeting is about (required when booking)

answers.description: [{ key, label, value }] — answers to the type's questions, with a snapshot of each question

timezoneGuest.description: Browser-detected IANA tz of the guest, for display only

googleEventId.description: Google Calendar event id (present after confirmed)

status.description: pending_verify | pending_payment | confirmed | cancelled | expired | payment_failed | refunded

holdExpiresAt.description: Paid types: the slot is held for checkout until then

amountCents.description: Paid types: price charged (from the meeting type, server-side)

paymentId.description: Set as soon as the payment is confirmed — a paid hold is never released

slotLock.description: userId|startUtc while the booking holds its slot; null once it doesn't

indexes.name: slot_lock_unique
indexes.description: Two bookings can't hold the same host + start. Options MUST live under `settings` (core/databases/jason/index.js only reads them there); partial on strings so released rows (slotLock null) don't block. Created by GET /api/data/bc_bookings/init — ensureIndexes never runs on its own.

create.description: Guests create pending bookings; server re-verifies before confirming
